name: Mall Cart Return Bay
summary: A two-place trolley corral with open entries, raised return signs and a centre divider.
description: Brushed steel rails, teal guides and raised cart pictograms mark two side-by-side supermarket return places. Each original shopping cart can be withdrawn independently over the flush entrance.
